policy.note: Do not synchronize every edit to every beat. Markers are broad dramatic cues; refine by hand.

structural_markers.name: NARRATION_START
structural_markers.note: Start of archive monologue (embedded estimate — edit if stem arrives)

structural_markers.name: NARRATION_END
structural_markers.note: End of primary narration span (editable; not auto-locked to beats)

structural_markers.name: MUSIC_END
structural_markers.note: Last frame of music / mixed master

structural_markers.name: TITLE_CARD_START
structural_markers.note: One Of God's Fools card begins (default last 4s — editable)

broad_cues.name: CUE_ENTRANCE
broad_cues.note: World / archive entrance — music breathes in

broad_cues.name: CUE_REST
broad_cues.note: Breath / bridge rest — do not fill with busy cuts

broad_cues.name: CUE_RELEASE
broad_cues.note: Release toward sister / holy-fool letting go

broad_cues.name: CUE_FINAL_PHRASE
broad_cues.note: Last living phrase before title card

proposal.tonal_centre_hint: E minor / modal — review against father's unfinished melody

appearances.human_family_melody: Singable / hummable contour in domestic register
appearances.loom_or_work_rhythm: Even pulse, shuttle-like repeats of the interval cells
appearances.dance_rhythm: Accent shift; same pitches, livelier subdivision
appearances.distorted_digital_pattern: Bit-crushed / time-stretched echo of the contour
appearances.too_perfect_memorial_loop: Quantized, airless loop — shadow of control
appearances.living_variation_at_end: Breathing rubato / sister's altered note kinship

dionysus_leitmotif.search_notes: No Dionysus theme audio/MIDI located in oino-interlude or repo assets. Textual mythic presence only. This cue is a reusable placeholder for music review.
